facts.text: Evan and his partner announced their marriage to their extended family on the previous day.

evidence.quote: My partner and I told our extended fam about our marriage yesterday – it was so special!

facts.text: Evan and his partner were standing on a rocky beach in a photo shared with Sam.

evidence.quote: image: a photo of a man and a woman standing on a rocky beach

facts.text: Evan expressed feeling lucky to have found someone who understands him.

evidence.quote: I feel really lucky to have found someone who gets me.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that his families are happy for their marriage and that this is the best part of the experience.

evidence.quote: our families are really happy for us - that's the best part!
